messages:
anya: FYI https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8821 - optimizer change landed, canary shows p95 tail bump on 4k sequences. Need quick eyes; aiming for merge window at 09:00 UTC if we can validate.
sam: link + short summary? what's regressed exactly? p95 numbers?
mike: short summary: p95 +28% on longseq, throughput ~-6% on 4k, mem +120MB per shard. small-batch perf unaffected.
anya: exactly. baseline p95 ~180ms -> now ~230ms on canary for our longseq workload. attaching microbench output below.
anya: ```
Benchmark: longseq-4k
baseline p95: 180.2 ms
canary p95:   230.4 ms
throughput:   940 req/s -> 880 req/s
mem per shard: 3.2 GB -> 3.32 GB
``` 
fiona: do we have a suspected root cause? optimizer change was kernel selection + prefetch tweak right?
mike: yeah, optimizer picks a different attention kernel for some sequence-length buckets; prefetchtune reduced async overlap. suspect scheduling change increases tail.
ci-bot: CANARY REPORT: runtime/canary/2026-03-18 - 15/20 checks passed. tail-latency threshold exceeded for model: redwood/longseq-4k. Details: https://ci.internal/canaries/8821
sam: can you paste the specific bench artifacts? need to compare heatmaps, gradings.
mike: perf dashboard: https://perf.internal/board/longseq/8821 and raw artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/8821/bench.tar.gz
anya: thanks. plan A: revert kernel-selection logic and re-run canary. Plan B: add canary flag + rollout gating for 24h. Which do we prefer?
fiona: revert seems safest given merge window in ~12h. if we revert now we can re-propose with more perf tests.
sam: I can approve a revert PR if someone opens it and adds the canary dashboard link + artifact reference. also add the label `safety/rollback`.
anya: opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8822 - revert commit + description + artifacts link. pinging for 1 approval.
mergebot: Merge window starts 09:00 UTC. PRs labeled `hotfix` or `safety/rollback` allowed in quick path. Requires 1 approval + green CI.
mike: I'll review 8822 in 20m and run a quick microbench locally. if green I will approve.
sam: approved after quick smoke (I ran a 30m microbench). results look back to baseline. :thumbsup:
mike: approved. I also added comment with the bench job id.
anya: excellent — merging 8822 now. will monitor canary for 2h after merge.
ci-bot: DEPLOY: revert PR 8822 merged and canary triggered (canary id: c-8822-2026-03-18-09). Monitoring started.
fiona: thanks all. if we see reoccurrence we'll open a postmortem and hold the optimizer rework behind a feature flag.
anya: will follow up with a brief writeup and next-steps in the PR. thanks for quick turnaround :heart:
